comment: Refero Styles layer pin. scripts/fetch-refero-styles.mjs reads this to fetch the public /v1/styles API that backs refero.design/styles. robots.txt on refero.design, api.refero.design and images.refero.design permits generic agents; the endpoints are public, unauthenticated, and every style page ships a public DESIGN.md download. There are no upstream versions to pin: discovery is the paginated list, so re-run npm run refero-styles to refresh (new records are fetched incrementally; --force refetches everything). See docs/DATA-SOURCE.md, 'The Refero Styles layer'.
